title: Equipment-identity source registry entry
description: Shape of one entry in source_registry.json -- a provenance record for a source of equipment identity/visual data, never itself a grant of usage rights (the nested `rights` object is the only thing that grants anything, and only once legalReviewState=REVIEWED -- see rights.py). Structural shape only; scripts/equipment_identity/rights.py is the actual enforcement.

sourceId.description: Stable, never reused once a source has ANY history -- other records (future asset/evidence entries) will reference this id.

priority.description: Must be one of the priorities `rights.CANONICAL_PRIORITIES_BY_SOURCE_CLASS` allows for this record's sourceClass -- not freely chosen per record. See core/equipment_identity/p0/SOURCE_PRIORITY.md.

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp this record's canonicalUrl/termsUrl were actually checked, not the record's creation date.

termsUrl.description: URL of the source's actual terms/license page, or null if none is known yet. null here does not imply permission -- rights.legalReviewState still governs.
